title: Elderly Couple Outdoors, 1944 Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor snapshot showing an elderly couple standing together along a dirt road or sidewalk during the World War II era in October 1944. The man wears a fedora hat, suspenders over a dress shirt with a patterned necktie, and high-waisted trousers. The woman is dressed in a classic 1940s patterned day dress and dark shoes. The back features a photo processor date stamp from October 17, 1944.
